AssessmentStatement.description:
A deterministic fact, risk or explicitly identified evidence gap.

Attributes:
    statement_id: Immutable identifier within one assessment.
    role: Observation, supported risk, or absence of applicable evidence.
    text: Plain source-backed description, not an unvalidated likelihood.
    evidence_ids: C1 evidence supporting a fact/risk; empty for a pure gap.
    metric_observation_ids: Exact C1 observations used in the statement.
    event_ids: Exact C1 events used in the statement.
    missing_metric_ids: Definitions whose evidence is missing or conflicting.

Raises:
    ValueError: A fact/risk lacks evidence, or a gap lacks its missing definition.
AssessmentStatement.title: AssessmentStatement

AttentionObservation.description:
Fresh exact-domain HN link count, outside all v1 C1 metric families.

A missing value means a truncated query; zero is valid only for a complete
bounded query. The count does not measure users, sentiment or success.

definition.default: HN stories linking the exact confirmed domain during the declared window; not broad mentions, sentiment, users or independent endorsement.
definition.title: Definition

AttentionObservation.title: AttentionObservation

CompanyAssessment.description:
Immutable company outlook without future labels or an invented success score.

Attributes:
    schema_version: Evidence-assessment contract version.
    assessment_id: Immutable assessment identity.
    company_id: C1 company identity, reusing verified organization identity.
    family_id: Effective family at as_of, or null for unresolved ownership.
    family_reason_codes: Explicit reasons when ownership is unknown/conflicting.
    source_snapshot_id: Exact verified C1 source publication consumed.
    policy_version: Deterministic evidence interpretation policy.
    as_of: UTC evidence/measurement cutoff for this assessment.
    first_recorded_at: Actual time the immutable assessment was first recorded.
    mode: Historical reconstruction or genuinely pre-cutoff prospective record.
    outcomes: Exactly the three separate outcome sections, including unknowns.
    statements: Source-linked facts, risks and missing-definition explanations.
    synthetic: Must match the source publication; fixtures never become real data.
    limitations: Publication/cohort restrictions retained for the consumer.

Raises:
    ValueError: Sections, references, dates or prospective provenance conflict.
CompanyAssessment.title: CompanyAssessment

CompanyDimensionModels.description:
Current experimental model overlay, separate from immutable assessments.

Attributes:

    company_id: Exact company evaluated from the selected source publication.
    source_snapshot_id: Exact source whose inputs were consumed.
    as_of: Measurement cutoff, not an assertion of historical model availability.
    model_bundle_sha256: Exact training-run manifest used for this overlay.
    dimensions: Five verified trained proxies, each with its own eligibility.
Raises:
    ValueError: The five dimensions are absent, duplicated or out of order.
CompanyDimensionModels.title: CompanyDimensionModels

CompanyOutcomeAssessment.description:
One prospective question explained from currently available evidence.

Attributes:
    outcome_id: Separate versioned company outcome, never a composite score.
    horizon_end: Exact calendar horizon derived from the assessment cutoff.
    assessment_status: Evidence-only facts, or unavailable relevant evidence.
    summary: Short explanation of facts/gaps without unsupported probability.
    statement_ids: Supporting/risk/gap statements in the containing assessment.
    reason_codes: Explicit limitations or reasons relevant evidence is absent.
    probability: Always null in this evidence-only contract version. A later
        validated prediction contract requires its own model/evaluation gate.

Raises:
    ValueError: An unavailable outcome lacks reasons, or facts lack statements.
CompanyOutcomeAssessment.title: CompanyOutcomeAssessment

DimensionModelView.description:
A trained proxy's availability, company eligibility and optional index.

Attributes:
    group_id: The dimension represented by this independent proxy model.
    model_status: Actual verified weights exist; this is not outcome validation.
    architecture: The portable baseline or validation-recommended comparator.
    target: Plain-language target, distinct from the three company forecasts.
    model_sha256: Exact fitted artifact digest, without local storage paths.
    eligibility: Whether this company's inputs support experimental inference.
    score: Training-outcome percentile, never a company-success probability.
    predicted_value: Model output in the explicitly named transformed units.
    prediction_unit: Units of the raw proxy prediction.
    metric_observation_ids: Exact source inputs consumed by this inference.
    reason_codes: Missingness, applicability and experimental-quality reasons.
    limitations: Training population and quality restrictions.
Raises:
    ValueError: An unavailable model carries a score or a prediction is partial.
DimensionModelView.title: DimensionModelView

OutcomeForecast.description:
An agreed product horizon without an approved label policy or model.

    horizon_months: Approved calendar-month horizon from the report cutoff.
    definition_status: Detailed labels/thresholds still require a data review.

    prediction: Always null; no probability or score is permitted.
    reason_codes: Both label-policy and model limitations, in display order.

SpecialistOutlook.description:
One group's source coverage, independent of its untrained model status.

Attributes:
    group_id: Fundamental metric group, not a success target.
    data_status: Available means some usable observations, not training-ready.
    metric_observation_ids: All assigned source observations, including gaps.
    usable_metric_observation_ids: Fresh verified public observations only.
    evidence_ids: Supporting evidence for usable observations only.
    reason_codes: Data limitations and the absent-model reason.
    model_status: Explicitly untrained; this version never serves forecasts.
    prediction: Always null until a separately gated serving contract exists.

Raises:
    ValueError: References repeat, usable references are absent, or coverage
        contradicts availability. Numerical forecasts are rejected.
SpecialistOutlook.title: SpecialistOutlook

StartupOutlook.description:
Five local-model placeholders attached to one exact company source vintage.

Attributes:
    schema_version: Additive research payload version; v1 assessments stay intact.
    company_id: Exact source company identity, not a user-entered name.
    source_snapshot_id: Immutable source publication consumed by the builder.
    as_of: Source cutoff, never the current request clock.
    grouping_policy_version: Version of the explicit metric-to-group mapping.
    synthetic: Source fixture flag retained for API/UI consumers.
    specialists: Exactly one section per group, including unavailable groups.
    unassigned_metric_observation_ids: Observations without an approved mapping.
    inference_runtime: Intended execution location; no inference has run.
    overall_outlook: Null; this contract cannot fabricate an outlook index.
    overall_reason_codes: Why a combined prediction cannot be served.
    forecasts: Three outcome placeholders for new reports. Absent in older
        reports; omitted on serialization to preserve their original bytes.

Raises:
    ValueError: Groups or observation assignments repeat or are incomplete.
StartupOutlook.title: StartupOutlook
